stock.description: Operating across the People's Republic of China, Beijing Media Corporation Limited and its associated enterprises deliver diverse media and related services. Its core business encompasses advertising sales for newspapers, magazines, and outdoor displays. The company's multifaceted operations are structured into distinct segments: generating revenue from media advertising, offering comprehensive printing solutions, facilitating the trade of essential print materials such as paper, inks, and specialized plates, and managing the distribution of newspapers, particularly those published by Chongqing Youth Daily. Furthermore, the company extends its offerings to include logistics and warehousing, investment management, travel services, and property leasing. Founded in 2001 and based in Central, Hong Kong, Beijing Media Corporation Limited functions as a subsidiary of the Beijing Youth Daily Agency.
